description: Reverse lookup: given only an image's 64-bit perceptual hash (16 hex chars), find registry entries whose final fingerprint is EXACTLY that value. Searches recent blocks only (no index exists yet), so a miss is not evidence of absence, and a resized or re-compressed copy may have a slightly different hash and not match. Returns every match: 64-bit hashes can collide, so several works may share one. A match locates a published chain head; obtain and verify that proof before drawing any conclusion.

maxRequests.description: Search budget. Default 24 (about 6 hours of history).

network.description: Base network. Defaults to the proof's own registry.chain, else Base mainnet. Use "sepolia" only for test registrations.

name: find_registrations_by_phash
title: Find registrations by image fingerprint
